context: Tests whether the agent correctly implements Automatic mode behavior: classifying findings as valid vs false positive, presenting a summary table before applying any fixes, and using Edit (preferred over Write) when applying code changes.

checklist.name: Valid classification
checklist.description: The plan or documentation identifies at least one finding as 'Valid' with a reason from: real bug, style issue, missing error handling, or security concern

checklist.name: False positive classification
checklist.description: The plan or documentation identifies at least one finding as 'False positive' with a reason from: irrelevant, debatable, or already handled in context

checklist.name: Summary table before fixing
checklist.description: A summary table or section listing 'Fixing N findings' appears in the output BEFORE any code change is described or applied

checklist.name: Fixing count shown
checklist.description: The summary explicitly states the number of findings to be fixed with brief descriptions of each

checklist.name: Skipping count shown
checklist.description: The summary explicitly states the number of findings to be skipped and includes a reason for each skip

checklist.name: No per-finding questions in auto mode
checklist.description: In Automatic mode, the plan does NOT ask the user about each individual finding — it shows the summary and proceeds to fix without per-finding prompts

checklist.name: Edit preferred over Write
checklist.description: Code fixes are applied using Edit tool (not Write) for modifying existing files

checklist.name: Read before fixing
checklist.description: The plan or script reads the relevant file for context before applying any fix

checklist.name: state.json updated after fixes
checklist.description: After fixes are applied, state.json is updated: fixed items appear in the 'fixed' array and skipped items appear in the 'skipped' array

checklist.name: Before/after code change shown
checklist.description: For each fixed item in the final report, the resolution describes what the code was before and what it became after the fix

checklist.name: Skip reason in report
checklist.description: For each skipped item in the final report, the resolution explains the specific reason it was skipped (false positive, design decision, or out of scope)
